purpose: Explicit, reviewed changes to pre-existing tools/ and assets/ files after a station integration froze them. Each entry pins the exact baseline and replacement Git blobs; any other difference still fails.

changes.reason: Correctness fix: topic-1 question text, figure side labels and answer key now share one AB/BC/AC assignment (63% of figures were swapped; 14% of answers contradicted the text).
Finite question banks: count inputs are capped to the declared bank at the current level with a visible note, and any unit that still comes up short is reported in the on-page status.

Curriculum alignment: six 國一 function units beyond the junior-high curriculum (quadratic, piecewise, replacement, composite, nested) are labelled 進階 and removed from the basic/advanced presets; level notes explain why.
New 國小高年級 topics (108 S-6-1/S-6-2, R-6, D-5-1/D-6-1/D-6-2): 放大縮小與比例尺, 規律與怎樣解題, 統計圖與可能性 — 17 units added to the engine; existing topics unchanged.
Math hub lists the three new 國小高年級 topics (cards 112 -> 115).

New 高一 topic 直線方程式 (108 數A第一冊, common to all three textbook editions): slope, point-slope/slope-intercept, two-point/intercept, general form, parallel/perpendicular, intersections, point-line distance.
Math hub lists the new 高一 topic 直線方程式 (cards 115 -> 116).
Grade 8 geometry: 11 new question types across congruence, bisectors, parallel and quadrilateral; existing units unchanged.
Grade 9: 10 new question types across righttri, quartile, boxplot and probability; existing units unchanged.
Math hub: section 國小三年級 becomes 國小中年級 and lists the four new g4-drills topics (cards 116 -> 120).
Math hub lists three more g4-drills topics: fraction, decimal, estimate (cards 120 -> 123).
Math hub lists the last three g4-drills topics: measure, perimeter, angle (cards 123 -> 126).
Math hub gains a 國小低年級 section with the four g2-drills topics (cards 126 -> 130); intro range now starts at 國小一年級.
Math hub lists five more g2-drills topics: multiply, money, time, length, shapes (cards 130 -> 135).
Grade 7: new topics 線對稱圖形 and 立體圖形與三視圖; existing topics unchanged.
Math hub lists the two new g7 topics (cards 135 -> 137).
Grade 8: new topic 尺規作圖 (reading constructions, values after constructing, justification); existing topics unchanged.
Math hub lists the new g8 topic 尺規作圖 (cards 137 -> 138).
